title: Notice regarding the listing of the oldest hundred matters
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
This
is
to
inform
the
learned
advocates
that
a
list
(Wednesday
Weekly
List)
of
hundred
oldest
cases
has
been
prepared
and
these
hundred
matters
would
be
split
up
in
batch
of
10
cases and
would
be
posted from
Monday
to
Thursday
(including
on
Wednesday).
These matters
would
be
taken
up
from
2.30 p.m.
onwards
and
no
request
for
adjournment
would
be
entertained. By
the
order
of
Hon'ble
Bench,
consisting
of
Hon’ble
Mr.
Justice
N.S.
Sanjay
Gowda
&
Hon’ble
Mr.
Justice
J.L.
Odedra)
